# Delivery RYT-NNN: title

## Outcome

User-visible behavior and the problem it solves.

## Scope and ownership

Owned paths, dependencies, assumptions and non-goals.

## Acceptance

Observable behavior, including loading/error/empty/forbidden states where applicable.

## Verification

Commands, role matrix and device evidence.

## Handoff and review

Changes, initial failures/corrections, actual results, evidence paths, unverified layers,
findings and remaining decisions. Producer updates the canonical ticket.
